testcase.name: volume-plugin/rbd

failure.message: In-tree volume plugin rbd removed in 1.31 (3 objects)

testcase.failure: In-tree volume plugin rbd removed in 1.31 (3 objects). 3 pods, PersistentVolumes or StorageClasses name it, in: cluster-scoped (2), data (1). From 1.31 a pod that names it, or that mounts a claim bound to a PersistentVolume that does, does not start. A StorageClass with provisioner kubernetes.io/rbd has its new claims provisioned by the in-tree plugin, so from 1.31 they are not provisioned. Objects: - pv-rbd - pv-unbound - sc-rbd Teams: storage Fix: redeploy the workload on a volume of the RBD CSI driver (ceph-csi); its CSI migration support was removed with the plugin. References: - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.31.md - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/124546 - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/118552

testcase.name: volume-plugin/awsElasticBlockStore
testcase.system-out: warning: In-tree volume plugin awsElasticBlockStore needs CSI driver ebs.csi.aws.com from 1.27 (2 objects). 2 pods, PersistentVolumes or StorageClasses name it, in: shop (2). From 1.27 the ebs.csi.aws.com CSI driver serves every operation on these volumes: a cluster without it installed cannot mount them, one with it is fine. A StorageClass with provisioner kubernetes.io/aws-ebs has its new claims provisioned by the in-tree plugin, so from 1.27 by that CSI driver. Objects: - pv-ebs Teams: payments Fix: install the ebs.csi.aws.com CSI driver (aws-ebs-csi-driver) before the upgrade. References: - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.27.md - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/115838
